snippets.ephemeral: al files lost on redeploy ). Local files lost on redeploy Like all Render services, Free web services have an ephemeral filesystem . This means that any changes to your web service's filesystem (uploaded images, local SQLite databases, etc.) are lost every time the service redeploys, restarts, or spins down . For long-term data storage: Paid services can preserve local filesystem changes by attaching a persistent disk , but Free web services cannot . Paid and Free services can persist relational data in a Render Postgres database. Note that Free Render Postgres databases expire 30 days after creation . Monthly usage limits

You can set the schedule in the service settings panel, under the Backups tab.
